verdict.rationale: Replit is an AI-powered app-building platform, so a training-data opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents any setting or policy that keeps user data out of AI model training. The general security controls (SSO/SAML, SOC 2, admin controls) are adjacent features, not a training opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
